title: John Titor
dek: The screen name behind posts from 2000–01 claiming to be a soldier from 2036 sent back to retrieve an IBM 5100.

prose.label: The posts
prose.body: Between November 2000 and March 2001, a user calling himself John Titor described civil war, time travel, and an IBM 5100 needed in 2036. The account then went silent.

prose.label: Aftermath
prose.body: No conclusive identity was proven. Later publicity treated the story as entertainment; the posts remain primary sources for how online folklore builds a person.

image_credit: No contemporary photograph of a verified individual.
